notes.title: December Xbox Games With Gold offerings tackle westerns and Chinese mythology
notes.content:
Microsoft has announced the next round of Games With Gold for Xbox One and Xbox Series X/S.

The games for December are 2D side-scrolling titles Colt Canyon and Bladed Fury.

Colt Canyon will be available for the entire month of December. In it, you are a gunslinger left for dead with a partner that has been kidnapped. On a mission to save your partner, you will venture to the unforgiving landscape of Colt Canyon, full of hidden treasures, weapons, danger, and ne'er-do-wells.

notes.title: Crown Trick comes out on October 16th!
notes.content:
[h2]Our new roguelike dungeon crawler game Crown Trick comes out on October 16th![/h2]
[previewyoutube=rmCmLzEqwSY;full][/previewyoutube]
Crown Trick is a turn-based roguelike in which you play as Elle. Armed with only your magical talking crown to guide you, you’ll develop your own combat style; choosing between active and passive abilities and utilising relics to aid you along the way.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30518600/a70f7614e282f31dfda73c80325ae57bee96756b.jpg[/img]

Mastering the elements will also be a key pillar to your survival, and upon vanquishing the high-level familiars found lurking in the labyrinth, you will be able to steal their skills and wield them as your own in your journey to escape the Nightmare Realm!

[b]Key Features:[/b]
[list]
[*] Engaging strategic gameplay: Monsters and traps move only when the player moves; carefully thought out strategies are key to escaping the labyrinthine dungeon
[*] Fight how you want: Create and develop a unique combat style with dozens of active and passive skills and abilities, items, and relics help create different ways to cut through enemy encounters
[*] Learn from enemies: Gather elite ‘Familiar’ skills by overcoming enemies ready to unleash on others deeper in the dungeon
[*] Different dungeons every time: The procedurally generated maze ensures players have unique experiences every time they enter the Nightmare Realm
[/list]
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/30518600/d6eb00f17df4daf686d00b9cd3562f07436488e7.jpg[/img]

notes.title: 版本更新v1.0.1820 01/02/2019
notes.content:
- 本次更新内容
Update Notes

1. 修复习得“流萤”或“星辉”技能后，季姜在空中使用闪避打断释魄或赤霄空中连招的次数未作限制的bug。
Fixed bug when "Sidestep" or "Starshine" is unlocked, "Shuffle" should not cancel Ji's air combo attacks without being limited by the maximun number of times she can evade in the air.

2. 优化跳跃操作手感，将短按跳跃键的最小跳跃上升时间从0.1秒提升到0.2秒。（长按跳跃键的最大上升时间和高度都未作改动）
Polished jumping control, increased the minmum jumping time from 0.1 second to 0.2 second.(Didn't change the maximun jumping time and height)

3. 优化季姜进入防御动作的动作节奏表现，并优化防御和完美防御判定精确度。
Polished both the animation presentation and accuracy of the "Precision Strike"(Perfect Guard).

notes.title: 版本更新v1.0.1819 12/26/2018
notes.content:
- 本次更新内容
1. 新增了手柄键位自定义功能。
2. 优化键盘键位自定义功能，加入对小键盘按键的支持。
3. 优化了键盘操作模式下，“魂识”技能的按键排布顺序。并对获得新魂识技能时的自动装备顺序也做了对应调整。
4. 在所有剧情对白画面右上角增加了“跳过”功能的UI提示。
5. 在第一章齐王宫，补充了“跳跃”操作技巧说明。并加入到Loading时随机出现的游戏提示中。
6. 在第三章永巷，新增了“蹲下与落下”的操作说明。
7. 赤宵“星辉”技能的霸体效果修改为：可免疫除抓取以外所有怪物技能的打断效果。
8. 赤宵“星辉”技能，新增了可使用闪避或防御打断赤宵攻击的效果（“奔雷”除外；“贯日”、“追云”起跳腾空阶段除外）。
9. 释魄“流萤”技能，新增了可使用闪避或防御打断释魄空中攻击的效果（“旋舞”除外；“重影”持续攻击阶段除外）。
10. 加快了释放“魂识”技能时季姜的动画节奏，缩短了不可操作状态持续时间。
11. 赤霄“贯日”技能的伤害值和破霸体值提升33%。
12. 从游戏内选择“主菜单”退回到标题界面时，新增需要做二次确认的弹出对话框，以尽量避免误操作。

notes.title: Bladed Fury is out now with killer looks at slashed price
notes.content:
Super-stylish platform hack n’ slasher Bladed Fury is out now. Heavily inspired by Muramasa: The Demon Blade on Wii and undoubtedly cribbing a bit of Vanillaware’s painterly art-style, it’s a gorgeous bit of Chinese mythological stabbery. A sword-swinging princess is accused of murdering her father, so goes on a quest to address this injustice by stabbing everything in her path instead, including all manner of demons, ghosts and skellingtons. I’ve really enjoyed what I’ve played of it so far and NEXT Studios have launched it at budget price. Check out the trailer below.

notes.title: An Open Letter to Our Players
notes.content:
We are very happy to announce that Bladed Fury is coming to Steam very soon. As developers, we are excited because after 16 months, we finally reached our goal to develop a Chinese-style action game, but we are also anxious because we are not sure how it will be received by our players. So we wrote this letter to calm ourselves down and to tell you more about the game.

　　　Bladed Fury is a 2D side-scrolling action game, based on the Warring States Period story of the "Usurpation of Qi by Tian", where the Jiang clan, ruler of the Qi State, was deposed and replaced by members of the Tian clan. We created an exciting world by adding imaginary technologies and fantasy elements to actual Chinese history. 

　　　In terms of design, we took inspirations from Muramasa: The Demon Blade, one of our developers' favorites, and used bold, vibrant colors on top of exaggerated physiques. We also used Chinese ink wash painting and traditional drama elements to show the game's roots in Chinese aesthetics. For combat, the familiar light/heavy attack system is used to generate combos. We also focused on making the movements smooth and fluid, while adding guard abilities and the Soul Sliver system to enhance the combat experience. We want to give players more freedom while they're fighting, so they can alternate between offense and defense instantly and experience the thrill of being in total control of the character.

　　　This game is developed by a group of action game enthusiasts, with relevant development experience in games such as Alice: Madness Returns, Moonlight Blade and Monster Hunter. We really wanted to create a high-quality action game that is developed by a Chinese team and full of Chinese elements, and Bladed Fury is the result. Of course there are things that we can improve on, and that's where you come in. Your feedback will not only help us improve this game, but will also give us ideas on how to make better games in the future. Our goal is to develop a game that's as good as Muramasa.

　　　 Finally, we hope you enjoy the game and give us a good rating.

notes.title: Platform brawler Bladed Fury is looking sharp in its latest trailer
notes.content:
I will always be a sucker for a stylish, combo-heavy platform brawler, and Bladed Fury is reminding me pleasantly of Vanillaware’s Muramasa on the Wii and Vita. Set in ancient mythological China, a princess attempts to clear her name against accusations of murder by stabbing a lot of people, apparently. In amongst its lushly drawn human villains there’s demons and skellingtons to be battered, or apparently shot with an ancient Chinese anti-tank cannon. NEXT Studio’s hack n’ slasher is due out next month on December 18th – take a peek at the very swish trailer below.
